target_customer: Cancer centers and oncology practices, and cancer patients directly through a telemedicine clinic
problem: Oncology nurses triage symptoms manually between visits, causing missed high-risk patients, ER visits and hospitalizations.
business_model: B2B SaaS to oncology providers plus a consumer telemedicine clinic

founders.name: Lily Tang
education: Harvard and Mass General Hospital training
founders.background_notes: YC page: over 10 years as medical physicist in radiation oncology and over 10 years in machine learning.

competitors.name: Kaiku Health
competitors.what: Digital symptom monitoring for cancer patients

competitors.name: Carevive Systems
competitors.what: Cancer symptom management pathways and remote symptom monitoring
competitors.funding_then: Cerner and Philips invested in an $18M round reported in 2021-02, about six months after the batch

technical_complexity.rationale: Rule based triage pathways with machine learning for risk detection; clinical validation and integration are the hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Clinical protocols are copyable and larger players (Elekta, Carevive) existed; any moat would come from clinical validation.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Elekta bought Kaiku in 2020; the company's own fate is unclear.

market_need_then: Symptom tracking improved cancer patients' outcomes in studies cited in trade press, and big vendors were buying into remote symptom monitoring in 2020.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; the spelling Liyfe is easily confused with Life clinic names.

pivots.from: Liyfe Clinic, telemedicine for breast cancer patients
pivots.to: AI digital nurse for oncology symptom triage
pivots.why: Not stated; YC page lists both the clinic and the platform

outcome_analysis: Liyfe is a two person oncology triage startup led by a medical physicist. No priced round or later traction was found beyond accelerator money, and a directory claims PitchBook marked it out of business by 2023, which I could not confirm. The cause of any stall is not public.
notes: Company website is blank in the directory, so no site was fetched. Funding conflicts among aggregators: CB Insights $130K over 2 rounds (YC, PharmStars), FundedIQ $100K non-equity in December 2021, Forbes and PitchBook via a secondary page reported $150K from YC; none recorded as rounds. A search summary names Sherry Chen as co-founder and CTO from a Product Hunt post I did not open, so not listed. Status unconfirmed: YC says Active, one directory says out of business. Completeness pass: Round recorded rests on a single database, CB Insights (accelerator round 2021-09, YC and PharmStars, $130K total over 2 rounds); amount left null because FundedIQ reports a conflicting $100K non-equity grant in 2021-12.
